explanation: I searched Mathlib for lemmas about Field.finSepDegree. The only change-of-field result is Field.finSepDegree_eq_of_equiv, in FieldTheory/SeparableDegree.lean. It compares two fields over the same base F that are related by an F-algebra equivalence. The target instead compares finSepDegree of f.fieldRange over L with finSepDegree of K over L, so the base field changes. Mathlib has no lemma for this, and none for the surjective-map version either. Field.finSepDegree_eq_of_surjective, which the proof uses, is in TauCeti's own FieldTheory/SeparableDegree.lean, so it does not count.
